lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest concentration and most uniform spacing in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately perpendicular angles, forming a series of anchor points where spots are centered within the grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the flank: one positioned on the upper-lateral boundary and two parallel ridges through the mid-section, each defined by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin shows a non-uniform distribution of small high-luminance spots, with a higher density observed along the leading edge and the upper trailing portion of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, slender, elongated silhouette is visible attached to the ventral-lateral area below the primary longitudinal ridges, characteristic of a remora.
